child.label: Luck & Fate
child.description: Questions about how much luck, chance, destiny, or fate shapes life, success, and relationships, and whether things happen for a reason.
child.not_for: Superstitions, omens, charms, horoscopes, and rituals to bring or avoid bad luck (use Superstitions & Omens).
examples: Do things happen for a reason?
How much of success is luck?

samples:
Which superstition do you actually follow?
none / knock_on_wood / lucky_charm_or_item / avoid_the_number_thirteen / avoid_walking_under_ladders

Do you have a lucky number, item, or ritual?
none / several / lucky_item / lucky_number / lucky_ritual

What do you do when you break a mirror?
feel_a_little_uneasy / clean_it_up_and_forget_it / do_something_to_undo_the_luck / joke_about_seven_years_bad_luck

What is your view of fortune telling, like tarot or palm reading?
a_scam / harmless_fun / it_can_help_reflection / it_can_reveal_the_future

What do you do when you find a penny on the ground?
leave_it / pick_it_up_for_luck / pick_it_up_its_money

What should you do after a string of bad luck?
change_something / nothing_its_random / wait_for_it_to_pass / do_a_ritual_or_cleanse

How superstitious are you?
I follow no superstitions at all / I follow one or two just for fun / I follow a few and feel uneasy if I skip them / I follow many and plan around them / I rarely do anything without checking for bad signs

How much stock do you put in your horoscope?
I never read it / I read it for fun and forget it / I read it and sometimes think about it / I let it shape some decisions / I plan my days around it

How much would you pay for an item said to bring good luck?
Nothing / A small amount as a fun keepsake / A fair amount / A lot, if it really worked

How much do you rely on lucky rituals before important events?
Never / I do one small thing out of habit / I do a few rituals / I feel I can't succeed without them

How would you react to a fortune teller predicting bad news for you?
Laugh it off / Forget it by the next day / Think about it for weeks / Change my plans because of it

How much do you avoid 'tempting fate', like saying a plan can't fail?
I say whatever I like / I sometimes catch myself / I usually avoid it / I always avoid it and knock on wood

child.label: Superstitions & Omens
child.description: Questions about superstitions, omens, jinxes, curses, lucky charms and numbers, horoscopes, and tarot, and how the answerer reacts to them.
child.not_for: Broad beliefs about luck, chance, destiny, or fate in life (use Luck & Fate).
examples: Does Friday the 13th make you nervous?
Do you knock on wood after jinxing something?
